--- title: "Data Viz I" author: "Dr. Adrian Correndo" date: "2026-01-30" categories: [figures, graphics, plots, ggplot2, tidyverse] format: html: toc: true toc-location: left toc-depth: 4 number-sections: true table-class: "table table-striped table-hover" self-contained: true editor: source smooth-scroll: true bibliography: ../../references.bib link-citations: TRUE --- **Description**
In this class, we will explore advanced visualization techniques using `ggplot2`. You'll learn how to fine-tune plots by modifying shapes, lines, legends, and adding custom titles and annotations. We will continue working with the **`agridat::lasrosas.corn`** dataset. ![](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/logo.png){.absolute top=0 right=0 height="25%"} # Learning Objectives By the end of this session, you will: 1. Customize plot aesthetics, including point shapes, line types, and colors. 2. Modify legends and axis labels for better readability. 3. Use annotations and text elements to highlight key data points. 4. Adjust themes and layouts for professional presentation. **Required Packages**
Install the necessary packages for this class: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(pacman) p_load("dplyr") # data wrangling p_load("ggplot2", "agridat", "patchwork", "ggtext") # plotting p_load("gganimate", "magick", "gifski") # animations ``` ::: # Datasets: Las Rosas Corn Data We’ll use the **`agridat::lasrosas.corn`** dataset, focusing on yield, nitro levels, years, and spatial data. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} corn_data <- agridat::lasrosas.corn %>% mutate(Year = as.factor(year)) glimpse(corn_data) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Rows: 3,443 Columns: 10 $ year 1999, 1999, 1999, 1999, 1999, 1999, 1999, 1999, 1999, 1999, 1999… $ lat -33.05113, -33.05115, -33.05116, -33.05117, -33.05118, -33.05120… $ long -63.84886, -63.84879, -63.84872, -63.84865, -63.84858, -63.84851… $ yield 72.14, 73.79, 77.25, 76.35, 75.55, 70.24, 76.17, 69.17, 69.77, 6… $ nitro 131.5, 131.5, 131.5, 131.5, 131.5, 131.5, 131.5, 131.5, 131.5, 1… $ topo W, W, W, W, W, W, W, W, W, W, W, W, W, W, W, W, W, W, W, W, W, W… $ bv 162.60, 170.49, 168.39, 176.68, 171.46, 170.56, 172.94, 171.86, … $ rep R1, R1, R1, R1, R1, R1, R1, R1, R1, R1, R1, R1, R1, R1, R1, R1, … $ nf N5, N5, N5, N5, N5, N5, N5, N5, N5, N5, N5, N5, N5, N5, N5, N5, … $ Year 1999, 1999, 1999, 1999, 1999, 1999, 1999, 1999, 1999, 1999, 1999… ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} nass_soybean <- agridat::nass.soybean %>% mutate(Year = as.factor(year)) select_states <- c("Kansas", "Iowa", "Illinois", "Missouri") glimpse(nass_soybean) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Rows: 2,528 Columns: 5 $ year 1924, 1924, 1924, 1924, 1924, 1924, 1924, 1924, 1924, 1924, 1924… $ state Alabama, Arkansas, Delaware, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, K… $ acres 3000, 3000, 12000, 10000, 115000, 66000, 10000, 2000, 9000, 8000… $ yield 6.5, 6.5, 11.0, 5.5, 12.0, 9.9, 12.0, 11.0, 9.5, 8.0, 11.8, 13.0… $ Year 1924, 1924, 1924, 1924, 1924, 1924, 1924, 1924, 1924, 1924, 1924… ``` ::: ::: # 1. Customizing ggplot2 Visualizations ## Define custom palettes ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} my_colors <- c("#1e6091", "#f9c74f", "#9b2226", "#599999", "#8e5572") years_colors <- c("1999" = "#1e6091", "2001" = "#9b2226") ``` ::: ## Histogram with Adjusted Transparency and Custom Bins ### i. First layers ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} corn_data %>% ggplot(aes(x=yield))+ # create the canvas with x axis defined geom_histogram(aes(fill = Year)) # add histogram layer with Year colors ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` `stat_bin()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value `binwidth`. ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](07_ggplot2_01_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### ii. Add more layers and labels ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Histogram histo_01 <- corn_data %>% ggplot(aes(x = yield)) + # Layers geom_histogram(aes(fill = Year), bins = 20, alpha = 0.6, color = "black") + geom_rug(aes(color = Year), alpha = 0.5)+ # Labels labs(title = "Yield Distribution Across Years", subtitle = "Las Rosas Corn Trials", x = "Yield (qq/ha)", y = "Count (#)") + # Scales scale_fill_manual(values = years_colors)+ scale_color_manual(values = years_colors)+ theme_bw() histo_01 ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](07_ggplot2_01_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-5-1.png){width=768} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # Faceting by Year histo_02 <- corn_data %>% ggplot(aes(x = yield)) + # Layers geom_histogram(aes(fill = Year), bins = 20, alpha = 0.6, color = "black") + geom_rug(aes(color = Year), alpha = 0.5)+ # Labels labs(title = "Yield Distribution Across Years", subtitle = "Las Rosas Corn Trials", x = "Yield (qq/ha)", y = "Count (#)") + # Scales scale_fill_manual(values = years_colors)+ scale_color_manual(values = years_colors)+ facet_wrap(~Year)+ theme_classic() histo_02 ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](07_ggplot2_01_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-5-2.png){width=768} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # Faceting by Year histo_03 <- corn_data %>% ggplot(aes(x = yield)) + # Layers geom_histogram(aes(fill = Year), bins = 20, alpha = 0.6, color = "black") + geom_rug(aes(color = Year), alpha = 0.5)+ # Labels labs(title = "Yield Distribution Across Years", subtitle = "Las Rosas Corn Trials", x = "Yield (qq/ha)", y = "Count (#)") + # Scales scale_fill_manual(values = years_colors)+ scale_color_manual(values = years_colors)+ facet_wrap(~topo)+ theme_classic() histo_03 ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](07_ggplot2_01_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-5-3.png){width=768} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # Faceting by Year histo_04 <- corn_data %>% ggplot(aes(x = yield)) + # Layers geom_histogram(aes(fill = topo), bins = 20, alpha = 0.6, color = "black") + geom_rug(aes(color = Year), alpha = 0.5)+ # Labels labs(title = "Yield Distribution Across Years", subtitle = "Las Rosas Corn Trials", x = "Yield (qq/ha)", y = "Count (#)") + # Scales scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors)+ scale_color_manual(values = my_colors)+ facet_wrap(~Year)+ theme_classic() histo_04 ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](07_ggplot2_01_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-5-4.png){width=768} ::: ::: ### Density plot ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} corn_data %>% ggplot(aes(x = yield)) + # Layers geom_density(aes(fill = Year), bins = 20, alpha = 0.6, color = "black") + geom_rug(aes(color = Year), alpha = 0.5)+ # Labels labs(title = "Yield Distribution Across Years", subtitle = "Las Rosas Corn Trials", x = "Yield (qq/ha)", y = "Count (#)") + # Scales scale_fill_manual(values = years_colors)+ scale_color_manual(values = years_colors)+ theme_bw() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning in geom_density(aes(fill = Year), bins = 20, alpha = 0.6, color = "black"): Ignoring unknown parameters: `bins` ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](07_ggplot2_01_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-6-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## Column/Bar plot ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Prepare summarized data frame aggregated_corn <- corn_data %>% group_by(Year, year, nitro, nf) %>% summarize(yield_mean = mean(yield), sd_yield = sd(yield)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` `summarise()` has grouped output by 'Year', 'year', 'nitro'. You can override using the `.groups` argument. ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # Column plot colplot_01 <- aggregated_corn %>% ggplot() + geom_col(aes(x = nf, y = yield_mean, fill = Year), color = "grey25") + # Triangle shape scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors)+ labs(title = "Yield vs. Nitrogen Levels", x = "Nitrogen (kg/ha)", y = "Yield (qq/ha)") + facet_wrap(~Year)+ theme_classic() colplot_01 ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](07_ggplot2_01_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-7-1.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # Add SD bars colplot_02 <- colplot_01 + geom_errorbar(data = aggregated_corn, aes(ymin = yield_mean - sd_yield, ymax = yield_mean + sd_yield, x = nf), width = .25) colplot_02 ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](07_ggplot2_01_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-7-2.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # facet by topography aggregated_topo <- corn_data %>% group_by(Year, year, nitro, nf, topo) %>% summarize(yield_mean = mean(yield), sd_yield = sd(yield)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` `summarise()` has grouped output by 'Year', 'year', 'nitro', 'nf'. You can override using the `.groups` argument. ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # dacet by topography and Year colplot_03 <- aggregated_topo %>% ggplot() + geom_col(aes(x = nf, y = yield_mean, fill = topo), color = "grey25", alpha = 0.5) + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = yield_mean - sd_yield, ymax = yield_mean + sd_yield, x = nf), width = .25)+ labs(title = "Yield vs. Nitrogen Levels", x = "Nitrogen (kg/ha)", y = "Yield (qq/ha)") + facet_grid(topo~Year)+ scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors)+ theme_classic() colplot_03 ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](07_ggplot2_01_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-7-3.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## Scatter Plot with Custom Shapes and Line Types ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # By year scatter_01 <- corn_data %>% ggplot(aes(x = nitro, y = yield, color = factor(year))) + geom_point(size = 3, shape = 17) + # Triangle shape geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed") + labs(title = "Yield vs. Nitrogen Levels", x = "Nitrogen (kg/ha)", y = "Yield (qq/ha)") + theme_minimal() # by topography scatter_02 <- corn_data %>% ggplot(aes(x = nitro, y = yield, color = topo)) + geom_point(size = 3, shape = 19) + # Circle shape geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dotted") + labs(title = "Yield vs. Nitrogen Levels", x = "Nitrogen (kg/ha)", y = "Yield (qq/ha)") + facet_wrap(~Year)+ theme_minimal() scatter_02 ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x' ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](07_ggplot2_01_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-8-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## BoxPlot with Custom Shapes and Line Types ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} corn_data %>% ggplot(aes(x = nf, y = yield)) + geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Year), color = "grey15", size = 0.5) + geom_jitter(aes(x = nf, y = yield, color=Year), size = 0.1)+ scale_fill_brewer(palette=2, type = "qual")+ scale_color_brewer(palette=2, type = "qual")+ labs(title = "Yield vs. Nitrogen Levels", x = "Nitrogen (kg/ha)", y = "Yield (qq/ha)") + facet_wrap(~Year)+ theme_classic() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](07_ggplot2_01_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-9-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: # 2. Axis & Titles ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} scatter_plot <- corn_data %>% ggplot(aes(x = nitro, y = yield, color = topo)) + geom_point()+ # Add labels labs(title = "Yield vs. Nitrogen", subtitle = "Data from Las Rosas Trials", x = "Nitrogen (kg/ha)", y = "Yield (qq/ha)") + # Add manual color scale scale_color_manual(values = my_colors)+ # Modify scale of x-axis scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,150), breaks = seq(0,150, by=30))+ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,90), breaks = seq(0,90, by=10))+ facet_grid(Year~topo)+ theme_classic() scatter_plot ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: Removed 786 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range (`geom_point()`). ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](07_ggplot2_01_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-10-1.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # Update scatter_plot + # Add regression line geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x + I(x^2), se = FALSE)+ theme(legend.position = "none", # Remove legend # Add panel border panel.border = element_rect(linetype = "solid", fill = NA), # Edit axis title text axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "red")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: Removed 786 rows containing non-finite outside the scale range (`stat_smooth()`). Removed 786 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range (`geom_point()`). ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](07_ggplot2_01_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-10-2.png){width=672} ::: ::: # 3. Annotating text ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} colplot_01 + scale_fill_manual(values = years_colors)+ geom_text(aes(label = round(yield_mean,0), x = nf, y = yield_mean + 3, color = Year))+ scale_color_manual(values=years_colors) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Scale for fill is already present. Adding another scale for fill, which will replace the existing scale. ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](07_ggplot2_01_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-11-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: # 4. Adjusting Themes for Presentation ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} base_plot <- ggplot(corn_data, aes(x = nitro, y = yield, color = factor(year))) + geom_point(size = 3) base_plot ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](07_ggplot2_01_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-12-1.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} base_plot + labs(title = "Fine-Tuned Yield vs. Nitrogen Plot") + theme_classic(base_size = 14) + # Larger base font theme(legend.position = "bottom") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](07_ggplot2_01_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-12-2.png){width=672} ::: ::: # 5. Combining Multiple Plots with Custom Layouts ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p1 <- scatter_plot p2 <- histo_02 # Combine using patchwork p1 + p2 + plot_layout(ncol = 1) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: Removed 786 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range (`geom_point()`). ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](07_ggplot2_01_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-13-1.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} p1 + p2 + plot_layout(ncol = 2) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: Removed 786 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range (`geom_point()`). ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](07_ggplot2_01_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-13-2.png){width=672} ::: ::: # 6. Animated plots ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} static_plot <- nass_soybean %>% dplyr::filter(state %in% select_states) %>% ggplot(aes(x = year, y = yield)) + geom_point(aes(fill = state, group = seq_along(year)), color = "grey15", shape = 21, size = 2, alpha = 0.5)+ scale_fill_manual(values=my_colors)+ #scale_color_manual(values=my_colors)+ facet_wrap(~state)+ theme_classic()+ # Add panel border theme(legend.position = "none", panel.border = element_rect(linetype = "solid", fill = NA)) static_plot ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](07_ggplot2_01_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-14-1.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} animated_plot <- static_plot+ transition_reveal(year) animated_plot ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](07_ggplot2_01_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-14-1.gif) ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # Render the animation # gganimate::animate(animated_plot, fps = 20, duration = 4, # width = 400, height = 300, # renderer = gifski_renderer()) # Save # anim_save(filename = "animated_plot.gif", animation = last_animation()) ``` ::: # Conclusion This tutorial provides various ggplot2 customization techniques relevant to agricultural research. Experiment with different styling options to enhance the clarity and impact of your visualizations! # Additional Resources for Data Visualization Here are some excellent resources to deepen your understanding of data visualization: 1. **[ggplot2 Documentation](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/)** – The official documentation for ggplot2 with comprehensive guides and examples. 2. **[R Graphics Cookbook](https://r-graphics.org/)** – A collection of practical recipes for creating a wide variety of graphics with ggplot2. 3. **[The Grammar of Graphics](https://www.springer.com/gp/book/9780387245447)** by Leland Wilkinson – The foundational theory behind ggplot2. 4. **[Data Visualization: A Practical Introduction](https://socviz.co/)** by Kieran Healy – An excellent resource for both beginners and advanced users. 5. **[Tidyverse Tutorials](https://www.tidyverse.org/learn/)** – Tutorials on ggplot2 and related packages in the Tidyverse ecosystem. 6. **[R Graph Gallery](https://r-graph-gallery.com/)** – A rich gallery of ggplot2 visualizations for inspiration and code snippets. Explore these resources to expand your visualization skills and stay updated with best practices in data presentation!
